description: Removes your ledger and returns a signed receipt with hashes only. One call, no reason asked. Cannot be undone; export first if you want a copy.

request.description: The owner-signed request (under 4 KB): v=1, type=ledger-delete, owner_id, owner_key, at, sig, plus the fields the tool needs.
